name: helban/gated-access-attribution
description: WooCommerce plugin: catalog gated behind email one-time codes, with server-side sales rep attribution on orders.

test:hpos: npx wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gated-access-attribution env GAA_TEST_ORDER_STORAGE=hpos vendor/bin/phpunit
test:posts: npx wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gated-access-attribution env GAA_TEST_ORDER_STORAGE=posts vendor/bin/phpunit
